svg.title: Wi-Fi Proxmox Talos CPU worker architecture
svg.desc: Git and Omni define a CPU-only Talos worker request. A Proxmox provider on the management NUC creates a VM on the Dell host and the worker joins the existing cluster through the ASUS media bridge.
